gen-gf-bellota-manrope: The s in Bellota throws its ends far from the spine, every stroke traced like one stylus. And Manrope lies beside it with bright open curves, friendly where the heading is forceful.
gen-gf-bellota-montserrat: Bellota hangs the ends of its s far from the spine. Montserrat sits beneath with generous white space before each curve and oversized e and a counters, so lines glide along like wire.
gen-gf-bellota-satoshi: Distinctive from the first glance, Bellota hangs the ends of its s far from the spine. Satoshi carries paragraphs comfortably, its wide e never looking squeezed shut beneath a soaring x-height.
gen-gf-bellota-switzer: Switzer is Swiss and approachable, tubular and wire-like, with c tips that never creep toward touching. But Bellota grabs attention with its far-flung s, while Switzer is the easier one to settle into.
gen-gf-bellota-work-sans: Bellota traces every stroke at the width of one stylus. Work Sans then carries paragraphs with a high mean line and joins that match its strokes, so reading feels modern and steady.
gen-gf-bellota-text-archivo: Archivo has an editorial, approachable feel, its curves opening outward and its x-height standing tall. And Bellota Text makes a strong heading with open shapes and no calligraphic shading, best given a size well above the body.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-asap: Bellota Text draws open shapes with no calligraphic shading. Make that heading small, though, and it loses its command beside Asap, whose readable body height nearly matches the capitals.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Bellota Text carries a commanding voice, its c, e, and s shapes open and free of calligraphic shading. And Be Vietnam Pro brings a clean, bent-steel-rod stroke with a high mean line, a crisp counterweight.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-epilogue: Commanding open shapes define Bellota Text, with no calligraphic shading. Epilogue brings curvy, unclamped letters and a tall lowercase on a wire-like monoline skeleton, so the gap in lowercase height becomes the standout.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-fira-sans: Bellota Text draws open c, e, and s shapes with no calligraphic shading to guide the eye. And Fira Sans holds up through paragraphs, its s curves opening wide at both ends, its x-height larger than usual.
